model.name: SANATAN AI 10M
model.architecture: 8 layers, d_model 288, 8 heads (head_dim 36), d_ff 880, RMSNorm + RoPE + SwiGLU, tied embeddings

pretrain.params_note: unique parameters (59 tensors); the tied token-embedding matrix is counted once. The exported bundle stores 60 tensors / 10,960,480 float32 values because the tied lm_head duplicate is kept for a simpler NumPy forward pass.
pretrain.weight_provenance: Trained from scratch. No weight transfer from the 5.77M model was possible: d_model 256->288, 6->8 layers and d_ff 688->880 change the shape of every tensor on the residual path, so no state_dict can be loaded. Function-preserving widening (net2net) was identified but not implemented.

held_out_evaluation.note: composite = 0.40 strict + 0.15 content F1 + 0.15 answer type + 0.20 grammar rules + 0.10 format; see scripts/eval_semantic.py

known_regressions: Composite semantic score is 13.2 points below the 5.77M production model (0.6842 vs 0.8161)
Conversational turn-boundary accuracy falls from 97.5% to 82.5%
Content F1 on the 40-item conversational set falls from 4.8% to 2.4%
Zero correctness on the capability items for dhaturupa, lakara, linga, purusha, samasa, correction, relevance and abstention
deployment_note: Deployed on explicit user instruction ('just deploy this 10M model'), not because the measurements show an improvement. The 5.77M checkpoint remains intact at artifacts/model.pt and is restored with scripts/export_numpy.py --checkpoint artifacts/model.pt.
